acne_activity.follicular_erythema.follic.medical_rationale: Focal red-feature density is the explicit follicular erythema proxy.

acne_activity.follicular_erythema.erythe.medical_rationale: Halo completeness combines continuity with the complement of boundary gradient.

acne_activity.follicular_papule.papule_d.medical_rationale: Filtered formal-fast YOLO count normalized by retained skin pixels; this is not a verified papule class.

acne_activity.follicular_papule.papule_a.medical_rationale: Filtered YOLO density gates global raised-texture burden; not segmented papule area or object-level overlap.

acne_activity.follicular_papule.p90_papu.medical_rationale: Global and focal redness co-burden; not redness localized to a detected papule.

acne_activity.follicular_pustule.pustule.medical_rationale: Filtered YOLO density gated by focal-red area is a class-limited co-burden proxy, not pustule classification.

acne_activity.follicular_pustule.p90_pus.medical_rationale: Focal redness and texture intensity co-burden; not redness localized to a classified pustule.
Filtered-YOLO presence gates global relief and texture intensity; not per-pustule height.

acne_activity.follicular_pustule.p90_whi.medical_rationale: Filtered-YOLO presence gates texture P90 instance area; no white/yellow-center classifier is present.

dry_fine_lines.density.fine_line_density.medical_rationale: Stage-1 fine-line coverage scaled per 100k standardized pixels is the fine-line density proxy.

dry_fine_lines.density.fine_line_length_.medical_rationale: Stage-1 fine-line coverage converted to standardized length-density scale.

dry_fine_lines.scale.p50_fine_line_lengt.medical_rationale: Minimum observed regional mean length explicitly targets the short fine-line branch.

dry_fine_lines.scale.short_fine_line_rat.medical_rationale: Center-pass share of recommended fine-line evidence proxies short-line prevalence.

dry_fine_lines.scale.p50_fine_line_width.medical_rationale: Fixed detector line width is the explicit standardized P50 width proxy.

dry_fine_lines.scale.narrow_fine_line_ra.medical_rationale: Narrow-line ratio is the bounded complement of standardized line width divided by four.

dry_fine_lines.scale.small_scale_texture.medical_rationale: Center-supported share of raw stage-1 evidence proxies small-scale texture.

dry_fine_lines.coverage.fine_line_networ.medical_rationale: Stage-1 recommended mask ratio is the explicit fine-line network coverage proxy.

dry_fine_lines.coverage.high_density_fin.medical_rationale: Stage-1 center mask ratio is the explicit high-density fine-line area proxy.

dry_fine_lines.direction_network.directi.medical_rationale: Spread across four observed region scores proxies directional dispersion.

dry_fine_lines.direction_network.crossin.medical_rationale: Midface convex/concave turns are the available crossing-density proxy.

dry_fine_lines.direction_network.branch_.medical_rationale: Jaw-curve direction changes are the available branch-density proxy.

dry_fine_lines.direction_network.multidi.medical_rationale: Regional line-share spread is the explicit multidirectional interweave proxy.

dry_fine_lines.direction_network.network.medical_rationale: Raw stage-1 line ratio is the network-texture proxy.

dry_fine_lines.visual_surface.p50_fine_l.medical_rationale: Minimum observed regional score explicitly targets low-contrast fine lines.

dry_fine_lines.visual_surface.low_mid_co.medical_rationale: Low/mid contrast is the complement of the four-region contrast proxy.

dry_fine_lines.visual_surface.short_disc.medical_rationale: Unsupported share of recommended evidence proxies short discontinuous lines.

dry_fine_lines.visual_surface.large_groo.medical_rationale: Complement of stage-2/stage-1 coverage explicitly measures large-groove exclusion.

stable_wrinkles.length.wrinkle_length_de.medical_rationale: Stage-2 stable-line coverage converted to standardized length density.

stable_wrinkles.length.p50_wrinkle_lengt.medical_rationale: Explicit four-observed-region mean length approximates P50 stable-wrinkle length.

stable_wrinkles.length.p90_wrinkle_lengt.medical_rationale: Maximum of four observed regional maxima is the explicit P90 length proxy.

stable_wrinkles.width_area.p50_wrinkle_w.medical_rationale: Stable-wrinkle P50 width uses the documented 1.25x fixed-width proxy.

stable_wrinkles.width_area.p90_wrinkle_w.medical_rationale: P90 width uses the documented 1.5x fixed-width detector proxy.

stable_wrinkles.width_area.wrinkle_area_.medical_rationale: Stage-2 recommended ratio is the stable-wrinkle area proxy.

stable_wrinkles.contrast.p50_wrinkle_con.medical_rationale: Four-region relative scores map explicitly to P50 contrast.

stable_wrinkles.contrast.p90_wrinkle_con.medical_rationale: Maximum observed regional score maps explicitly to P90 contrast.

stable_wrinkles.contrast.high_contrast_w.medical_rationale: Fraction of observed regions above relative score 50 is the high-contrast share proxy.

stable_wrinkles.linearity_continuity.wri.medical_rationale: Center-supported share of raw stage-2 evidence is the stable-line linearity proxy.

stable_wrinkles.relative_depth.mean_wrin.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by stable-wrinkle coverage is the mean-depth proxy.

stable_wrinkles.relative_depth.p90_wrink.medical_rationale: Midface P90 relative relief is the explicit P90 wrinkle-depth proxy.

structural_grooves.range.groove_continuo.medical_rationale: Center-supported raw stage-2 share, explicitly clipped to 0-1, proxies continuous groove length.

structural_grooves.range.p50_groove_widt.medical_rationale: Structural-groove P50 width uses the documented 2x fixed-width proxy.

structural_grooves.range.p90_groove_widt.medical_rationale: Structural-groove P90 width uses the documented 2.5x fixed-width proxy.

structural_grooves.depth.mean_groove_rel.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by center-supported groove coverage proxies mean groove depth.

structural_grooves.depth.p90_groove_rela.medical_rationale: P90 relief gated by texture intensity is the structural-groove P90 depth proxy.

structural_grooves.volume.normalized_gro.medical_rationale: Relative depth times groove coverage and standardized width gives normalized groove volume.

structural_grooves.volume.groove_volume_.medical_rationale: Relative volume divided by observed maximum length is the unit-length volume proxy.

structural_grooves.curvature_valley.clea.medical_rationale: Center-supported stage-2 share proxies clear valley segments.

structural_grooves.curvature_valley.vall.medical_rationale: Midface continuity gates retained stage-2 groove evidence to proxy valley-floor continuity.

structural_grooves.curvature_valley.groo.medical_rationale: Jaw curvature gated by structural-groove coverage is the groove-curvature proxy.

structural_grooves.curvature_valley.surf.medical_rationale: Curvature gated by surface continuity is the transition proxy.

structural_grooves.adjacent_bulge.groove.medical_rationale: Adjacent height difference explicitly combines relative relief and curvature variation.

structural_grooves.adjacent_bulge.normal.medical_rationale: Relief, continuity loss, and raised texture jointly define adjacent-bulge volume.

smoothness.raised_irregularity.raised_de.medical_rationale: Texture density gated by the raised-instance share gives raised density.

smoothness.raised_irregularity.mean_rais.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by raised coverage proxies mean raised height.

smoothness.raised_irregularity.p90_raise.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by P90 texture intensity and raised coverage proxies P90 raised height.

smoothness.raised_irregularity.raised_vo.medical_rationale: Relief times raised coverage and intensity is the normalized raised-volume/area proxy.

smoothness.depressed_irregularity.depres.medical_rationale: Texture density gated by the depressed-instance share gives depressed density.

smoothness.depressed_irregularity.mean_d.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by depressed coverage proxies mean depth.

smoothness.depressed_irregularity.p90_de.medical_rationale: Relative relief gated by P90 intensity and depressed coverage proxies P90 depth.

smoothness.depressed_irregularity.depres.medical_rationale: Relief times depressed coverage and instance intensity is normalized depressed volume/area.

smoothness.depressed_irregularity.p90_de.medical_rationale: Relative curvature gated by depressed coverage proxies edge slope.

smoothness.surface_attachment.flake_lift.medical_rationale: Raised texture overlapping punctate attachment evidence proxies lifted flakes.

contour_firmness.lower_face_sagging.mout.medical_rationale: Mouth-corner depression combines asymmetry with continuity loss.

contour_firmness.lower_face_sagging.othe.medical_rationale: Other lower-cheek bulge combines relief, raised texture, and asymmetry.
